<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 480" width="100%" height="100%">
  <!-- White background rect -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Standard O-Level / A-Level styling: clean black lines, sans-serif -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16">

    <!-- Left Beaker (Zinc half-cell) -->
    <path d="M 120 180 L 120 340 Q 120 360 140 360 L 240 360 Q 260 360 260 340 L 260 180" />
    <!-- Left Solution level -->
    <path d="M 122 230 L 258 230" stroke-dasharray="6,4" />

    <!-- Right Beaker (Copper half-cell) -->
    <path d="M 440 180 L 440 340 Q 440 360 460 360 L 560 360 Q 580 360 580 340 L 580 180" />
    <!-- Right Solution level -->
    <path d="M 442 230 L 578 230" stroke-dasharray="6,4" />

    <!-- Zinc Electrode -->
    <rect x="175" y="160" width="20" height="150" fill="#cccccc" stroke="#000000" />

    <!-- Copper Electrode -->
    <rect x="495" y="160" width="20" height="150" fill="#b87333" stroke="#000000" />

    <!-- Salt Bridge (inverted U-shape dipping into both beakers) -->
    <path d="M 210 260 L 210 200 Q 210 120 350 120 Q 490 120 490 200 L 490 260" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="square" />
    <!-- Salt bridge inner white mask to make it look like a tube/strip -->
    <path d="M 210 260 L 210 208 Q 210 132 350 132 Q 490 132 490 208 L 490 260" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="square" />
    <path d="M 210 260 L 210 200 Q 210 120 350 120 Q 490 120 490 200 L 490 260" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Cotton wool plugs on salt bridge ends -->
    <line x1="202" y1="250" x2="218" y2="250" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="482" y1="250" x2="498" y2="250" stroke-width="3" />

    <!-- External Circuit Wires and Voltmeter -->
    <path d="M 185 160 L 185 90 L 310 90" />
    <path d="M 390 90 L 505 90 L 505 160" />

    <!-- Voltmeter Circle -->
    <circle cx="350" cy="90" r="40" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="350" y="96" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="28" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000" stroke="none">V</text>

    <!-- Labels and Text (Using Times New Roman for chemical formulae and italic variables per convention, Arial for normal text) -->
    <g font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="18" fill="#000000" stroke="none">
      <!-- Electrodes -->
      <text x="185" y="340" text-anchor="middle">Zn</text>
      <text x="505" y="340" text-anchor="middle">Cu</text>

      <!-- Solutions -->
      <text x="190" y="285" text-anchor="middle" font-style="italic">aq. ZnSO</text>
      <text x="235" y="291" font-size="14" font-style="italic">4</text>
      <text x="250" y="285" font-size="14" font-style="italic">(stat.)</text>

      <text x="510" y="285" text-anchor="middle" font-style="italic">aq. CuSO</text>
      <text x="555" y="291" font-size="14" font-style="italic">4</text>
      <text x="570" y="285" font-size="14" font-style="italic">(stat.)</text>

      <!-- Salt Bridge label -->
      <text x="350" y="110" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">salt bridge</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Figure Caption -->
    <text x="350" y="420" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000" stroke="none">Fig. 6.1</text>

  </g>
</svg>
